outcome: Standardize employee support and service requests across one manufacturing or distribution business, with measured service performance and approved fulfillment workflows.
overview: Give manufacturing and distribution employees one route for support, equipment requests and access approvals. The proposed service establishes a single service desk with ten request types, an initial asset register and visible ownership. Focus on reducing support delays affecting employees and business applications. The service does not replace manufacturing execution or plant control systems.
kpi: Median incident resolution time, self-service adoption, SLA attainment and fulfillment cycle time.
scope: Planning estimate: six to eight weeks after prerequisites, covering one service desk, ten request types, one integration and an initial asset import. Stages: process design, configuration, import rehearsal, approval testing, representative-user pilot and handover. Asian Paints reports an eight-week implementation in its own case [CX-FS-AP]. Customer scope and dependencies determine the delivery schedule. Existing service benchmark: Freshworks Onboarding Packages, covering onboarding guidance and administrator training [CX-FW-PS].

prerequisites: Agreed access for the service team
A current inventory of what is covered
